comingLast.roast: in on 22 - now begins the long nervous wait at the bar
the rescue mission: 4 points, 1 holes, no pressure at all
8 points from 6 holes - entirely gettable, famously not got
finished 3 above the blue line - toasting every point Heggaton does not score
in the clubhouse, 3 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
in on 4 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
